overview: DBANK is a decentralized finance (DeFi) banking app running on the Internet Computer. Users authenticate with Internet Identity, manage a wallet account, make deposits and withdrawals, earn simulated yield at 5% APY, and view full transaction history — all powered by a Motoko smart contract backend.
features: Login with Internet Identity — secure, decentralized authentication
Account dashboard with live balance, total deposits, total withdrawals, and earned interest
Deposit and withdrawal forms with balance validation and instant feedback
Transaction history with filtering by type (all/deposits/withdrawals) and scrollable list
5% APY yield accrual displayed in real-time on the dashboard
Dark and light mode toggle with persistent preference
Responsive layout for desktop, tablet, and mobile
